strategy_name: HL supertrend+bollinger causal top-15 (no hindsight universe)

replaces.why: it ran the top-15 resolved on 2026-07-06 (hindsight universe); 1 evaluation, 2 fills, nothing lost

schedule: daily at 11:59 UTC (the strategy's 1d bar closes at 12:00 UTC)
auto_pause: after 28 days without an owner visit to the Keel web app
expectation: honest backtest of this exact strategy: OOS Sharpe 1.15 / +43.5% / max DD -30%; full window Sharpe 0.76 / max DD -58% with two -28% quarters. A paper drawdown of -30% is inside the tested range and is not by itself a reason to stop.
go_live_criteria: >= 21 days and >= 20 evaluations of paper (Keel's own graduation gates) whose fills track the backtest (parity within 50 bps; drift explained by the fill model only)

>= 150 USD on the Hyperliquid account: with min_trade_size 0.05 about 2% of orders fall under the $10 minimum at $150 (Keel realism: <25% from ~$64, <5% from ~$100); with 48 USD it is not worth running
no new out-of-sample quarter with Sharpe < 0.5 AND return below the BTC hold over the same quarter
Angel decides the leverage in the Keel web app: 1x is the tested setting; every x above 1 multiplies the -58% historical drawdown

keel_graduation_thresholds.note: Keel's own paper->live readiness gates, read from keel_live_monitor on 2026-10-31
